verdicts.rule: T, mN = 1, Lambda 10 and 100, N 100 and 200: V* >= 0.9 in all four
M does not land in V* at mN = 1 for any N, Lambda; V* at N = 400 below 0.5 with U the modal class (falsifier: lands anywhere, or V* >= 0.5 at N = 400)
M, mN = 1: V*(100) - V*(0) <= +0.05 at every N (falsifier: > +0.10 with interval excluding 0)
mN = 0, N = 100: W share at 120N lower at Lambda = 100 than at 0 by >= 0.10 in both arms (falsifier: < 0.05 in either)
RE 5's common bound fails in at least one arm (reduction < 0.10 in M or T)
mN = 0: no arm reaches V* >= 0.6 at any N and Lambda <= 100 (falsifier: any cell >= 0.6)
T, mN = 1, Lambda = 100: fair-consensus runs uniform over the pairs (exact multinomial p > 0.01; unscored with < 20 consensus runs)
D1 raises M V* at N = 100, mN = 1 by >= 0.15 over the full tail (falsifier: < 0.05)
RE 8 fails (gain < 0.10), and fails at N = 200 (scored on the numbers; the timing mechanism was refuted analytically before the run)
gain at N = 200 < gain at N = 100 and < 0.05

verdicts.verdict: M held / T failed / L held
verdicts.rule: holds for an arm if it does not land (V* >= 0.95, lower bound >= 0.90) in the mN = 1, Lambda > 0 cells at the largest N run
M's V* at mN = 1, Lambda = 100 strictly falls in N with mean(400) < mean(100) - 0.3
N = 400, mN = 1, Lambda = 100: unequal-consensus runs T0 - T >= 2
N = 200, mN = 1, Lambda = 100: D2 gain - mean D4 gain >= 0.10
M, N = 100, mN = 1: V*(Lambda = 100) - V*(0) > +0.10 with interval excluding 0

V3.note: per-run universe = founders + all scheduled arrivals (Lambda = 100 schedule), so every program an arrival can bring has an entry against every pair that can be present; migrants copy residents

V4.note: the table is built from many_islands_t.Tabs (the queue-69 table); no stored per-triple table exists to compare with, so it is checked against Tabs.payoff and against an independent counted re-evaluation

modal_tie_break.note: argmax breaks exact ties by the lowest outcome id, which is not rotation equivariant; the frequency of ties at the recorded snapshots is reported per cell in the rows (snap[..].ties)

V5.triple: slot 0: (1,2/3) constant, slot 1: (0,1/3) constant, slot 2 resident (ALL,2/3); opener (1,1/2); switch (2,1/2)
